ai_summary.headline: Cash is about a third of the LRP, but regular MPCA funding is thin and transfers sit far below the MEB.
ai_summary.narrative: Cash in Lebanon sits across three funding instruments, not one plan. The Lebanon Response Plan (LRP, $1.62bn, 2.99m in need) stays the primary framework [s1]; a Flash Appeal ran March to August ($639.9m) and an LRP Addendum covers September to December ($385.9m) [s2][s3]. Cash Working Group sector requirements are $321.5m (LRP), $134m (Flash Appeal) and $104m (Addendum) [s3]. Planned direct CVA is $586.8m, 36% of the LRP, with MPCA 51% of it [s4]. Partners report only 10% of the LRP cash appeal received, but they disbursed $100.7m in regular and $76.5m in emergency cash, so reporting likely understates delivery [s5]. The Flash Appeal reached 1.66m people, 228% of target, mostly through single instalments [s5]. Displaced Syrian households receive up to $145 a month against an MEB of about $700 for five people [s4][s7]; this appears to be a deliberate trade of depth for coverage. An LRP 2027 cash chapter is in preparation [s8].
barriers: Regular LRP cash only 10% funded on partner reporting (likely under-reported)
Transfers (up to $145 a month) far below the MEB (about $700 for five)
Three overlapping instruments and no LRP in FTS make tracking hard
Social protection coverage limited: AMAN assists about 800,000 Lebanese, roughly half of those in poverty
opportunities: Shock-responsive alignment with MoSA and AMAN, with MoSA as CWG co-lead
Addendum MPCA already 46% funded; common delivery via FSP mapping can lower costs

total_funding_usd.note: All incoming funding to the plan, pledges excluded. Matches the FTS plan summary.

mpc_usd.note: FTS single-cluster view of the Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) cluster; shared-cluster view US$50.9M. Incoming flows, pledges excluded.

ctp_usd.note: All flows tagged 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)', inside or outside the MPC cluster.

sectoral_cva_usd.note: Flows whose FTS modality field is 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)' and whose destination cluster is not multi-purpose cash: 28 flows. The CTP tag is set by the reporting donor or agency and is not applied consistently, so this is a floor, not a measure of sectoral cash. Largest: Protection US$6.2M, Food Security and Agriculture US$6.0M, Shelter & SMC US$2.1M.

cva_usd.note: Union of the MPC cluster and the CTP tag. Widest defensible FTS cash figure; still a floor because untagged sectoral cash is invisible.

mpc_pct_of_total.note: MPC cluster funding as a share of total plan funding (single-cluster view).

fts_cva.caveat: FTS records funding, not transfers to people, and only to first-level recipients. Sectoral cash depends on a modality tag that reporters apply unevenly.
